project.title: Membrane-aerated biofilm reactors metagenome raw sequence reads
project.description: This research is to study the influence of protozoan predation in membrane-aerated biofilm reactors (MABRs). Bacterial/archaeal and eukaryotic sequencing results in MABR biofilms and inoculum were analyzed.
